lines.text: Your agent finishes its job, then sits there in a terminal. You only find out when you look.
So you keep checking. Another tab, another terminal, another look at the output.
With the Agent R Q M C P tools, the agent can report on its own work, without you asking.
When it starts, the agent marks its own task ongoing, so the board shows that someone has it.
On your board the card moves by itself, from not started to ongoing, with no one dragging it.
If it gets stuck, it asks, with a real question, instead of staring at a terminal in silence.
You answer from your phone, in one line, and the agent carries on.
When it ends, it replies with a summary of what changed, so you read one note, not a diff.
Then it marks the task completed, and you get a notification that it is finished.
No polling, no guessing. You are in the loop without ever watching a terminal.
Claude, Codex, Gemini, any agent that speaks M C P can report in the same way.
How do your agents tell you they are done today? Share it, or try this at Agent R Q dot com.
